clue.text: His fare is nevertheless expensive in France

definitions.note: the fare here is food on sale, so this means the man whose stock is meat

parts.note: nevertheless can be replaced by but, as in 'but he went anyway'
cher is the French word for dear or expensive

explanation.surface: A remark that something is still pricey across the Channel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'His fare' points at a tradesman by what he sells: the meat on his counter.
explanation.definitionFit: A meat retailer's fare, his goods for sale, is joints and chops, so the man selling them is described.

clue.text: Meditate in bed if bewildered

indicators.note: in tells us the word for meditate sits inside the word bed

parts.note: taken as written
to muse is to meditate or ponder

explanation.surface: Lying in bed thinking leaves one muddled.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone bemused is puzzled and confused, a synonym of bewildered.

clue.text: Mediterranean port is fuller-flavoured

explanation.surface: A North African harbour city with a stronger taste.
explanation.walkthrough: Tangier sits on the Strait of Gibraltar at the Mediterranean's western mouth; the setter counts it as a Mediterranean port.
explanation.definitionFit: Tangier is a Moroccan harbour city; something with more tang has a stronger, sharper taste.

clue.text: Dog Dad's Army?

parts.note: a guard dog protects a house, and Dad's Army is the British TV sitcom about the WWII volunteer defence force of older men

explanation.surface: A question linking a pet with a classic British sitcom.
explanation.walkthrough: Dad's Army is a much-loved British sitcom about elderly volunteers defending a seaside town in the Second World War.
explanation.definitionFit: Britain's wartime volunteer defence force is the subject of the sitcom Dad's Army, and a watchdog also protects the house.

clue.text: I learnt to become trusting

indicators.note: the letters of 'I learnt' turn into a different word, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone learning to have faith in others.
explanation.definitionFit: Being reliant means depending on someone, so it is close to trusting.

clue.text: Let none of the debt be paid

definitions.text: none of the debt be paid

explanation.surface: Allow a borrower to settle nothing at all.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition reads the answer split as ALL OWED: every penny still due.
explanation.definitionFit: To be let is to be permitted; if none of a debt is paid, the whole sum is still due.

clue.text: After a month it contains firm fruit

indicators.note: After says the next piece comes behind the month's abbreviation

parts.note: Apr is the short form of April

indicators.note: contains means the word it holds the firm's abbreviation

parts.note: taken as written
Co is short for company, a firm

explanation.surface: A fruit that ripens a month on, holding firm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contains' puts CO inside IT to make ICOT, which follows APR.
explanation.definitionFit: An apricot is a small orange stone fruit.

clue.text: Many a remarkable man is solitary

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty, a large number, so many
a oner is an old slang term for an outstanding person

explanation.surface: A claim that exceptional people tend to keep to themselves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Many' giving L (fifty in Roman numerals) is a crossword convention; ONER is British slang for someone unique.
explanation.definitionFit: Solitary can be a noun for a recluse, someone who lives apart from others.

clue.text: RAF unit dined with Chindit chief

parts.note: a wing is a formation of the Royal Air Force
dined means ate

explanation.surface: An air force squadron having a meal with a jungle commander.
explanation.walkthrough: The Chindits were a British long-range jungle force in wartime Burma, led by Orde Wingate.
explanation.definitionFit: Major-General Orde Wingate founded and commanded the Chindits behind Japanese lines in Burma.

clue.text: Physician admitted being inundated

parts.note: Dr is the abbreviation for doctor, a physician
to own up is to admit, so owned means admitted

explanation.surface: A doctor confessing he was swamped with work.
explanation.definitionFit: Drowned land is flooded, so it means submerged or overwhelmed by water.

clue.text: A pound note initially made very small

indicators.note: initially says the note comes first, ahead of the other pieces

parts.note: a minim is a musical note, a half note
L is the abbreviation for pound, from the Latin libra

explanation.surface: A tiny banknote produced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' looks like a first-letter signal but says MINIM goes at the front, before A and L.
explanation.definitionFit: Minimal means the least possible, so it describes something tiny.

clue.text: Encounter causes argument to follow

indicators.note: follow says the little word to comes after the quarrel word

parts.note: a run-in is a quarrel or dispute

explanation.surface: A meeting that leads to a row.
explanation.definitionFit: To run into someone is to meet them by chance.

clue.text: Army supporter served with a drink

explanation.surface: A soldier's equipment handed out with a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: A sling is the strap supporting a soldier's rifle (or an injured arm); a gin sling is a cocktail.
explanation.definitionFit: A sling is a strap carrying a rifle or holding up an arm; it is also a spirit-based cocktail.

clue.text: Find out about sectarian differences

indicators.note: differences suggests the letters of sectarian take a different order

explanation.surface: Investigate religious divisions.
explanation.definitionFit: To ascertain is to establish or discover a fact for certain.

clue.text: Prohibition keeping Sandhurst inactive

indicators.note: keeping means the word for prohibition holds the academy's initials

parts.note: don't is a prohibition, a command forbidding something
RMA is the Royal Military Academy at Sandhurst

explanation.surface: A ban that keeps the military academy idle.
explanation.walkthrough: Sandhurst is Britain's officer training college, the Royal Military Academy.
explanation.definitionFit: Dormant means asleep or inactive, like a volcano not erupting.

clue.text: Nurse grabs top-class trainee by the rump

indicators.note: grabs means the word for nurse closes around the next pieces

parts.note: to tend is to nurse or care for
A1 means first-rate; the 1 is read as letter I
L is for learner, from the L-plates of learner drivers

explanation.surface: A nurse seizing a promising student by the backside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top-class' gives A1, written AI; L comes from the L-plates on a British learner's car.
explanation.definitionFit: The tail end is the hindmost part, which is what a rump is.

clue.text: I am to act as arbiter next

parts.note: contracted to I'm
to mediate is to act as go-between or arbiter

explanation.surface: Someone volunteering to referee the following dispute.
explanation.definitionFit: Immediate can mean nearest or adjacent, as in the immediate neighbour, so next.

clue.text: Contract to construct a viaduct

parts.note: a viaduct is a long bridge carrying a road or railway

explanation.surface: An agreement to build a railway crossing.
explanation.definitionFit: To abridge a text is to shorten or condense it.

clue.text: The first male worker to be really resolute

parts.note: Adam is the first man in the Bible
the worker ant is a crossword staple for worker

explanation.surface: The first man and a labourer showing real determination.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone adamant is unshakeable in their position, utterly determined.

clue.text: Need about 25 sheets

parts.note: re means concerning or about
a quire is a quantity of paper, traditionally twenty-four or twenty-five sheets

explanation.surface: Wanting roughly two dozen sheets of paper.
explanation.definitionFit: To require something is to need it.

clue.text: Some rotten treatment suffered by those who beg

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Beggars often meet with nasty treatment.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is cryptic: those who beg do the action, as in 'entreat is what they do'.
explanation.definitionFit: To entreat is to plead or implore, the action carried out by those who beg.

clue.text: Rex strolled and strolled

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for Rex, Latin for king
strolled means ambled, walked at leisure

explanation.surface: A dog named Rex out walking.
explanation.walkthrough: The repeated word is the trick: one 'strolled' gives AMBLED, the other is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Rambled means wandered or walked for pleasure without a fixed route.

clue.text: MP makes Labourites accept EU farming policy

indicators.note: accept means the word for Labourites takes in the policy initials

parts.note: Reds is slang for left-wingers such as Labour supporters
CAP is the European Union's Common Agricultural Policy

explanation.surface: A Member of Parliament getting Labour backing for European farm subsidies.
explanation.walkthrough: MP here is Military Police, not Member of Parliament; British military police are nicknamed redcaps.
explanation.definitionFit: British military police are known as redcaps from the red covers on their caps.

clue.text: Bound to find female in the van

indicators.note: in tells us the female pronoun goes inside the word for van

parts.note: the van is the front or lead position
she is the female pronoun

explanation.surface: A woman tied up in the back of a vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'van' is not a vehicle but the vanguard, the leading position.
explanation.definitionFit: Leashed means tied up or restrained, as a dog on a lead is held back.

clue.text: Recoiled from adder disturbed by Edward

indicators.note: disturbed suggests the letters of adder are jumbled

parts.note: Ed is a short form of Edward

explanation.surface: Edward startling a snake and backing away in fear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' turns ADDER into DREAD, followed by ED.
explanation.definitionFit: If you dreaded something you shrank from it in fear, so recoiled from it.

clue.text: Airman left despite being found innocent

parts.note: AC is short for aircraftman, the lowest RAF rank
quitted is a form of quit, meaning left or departed

explanation.surface: A pilot who deserted yet was cleared at court martial.
explanation.definitionFit: A defendant acquitted is declared not guilty by a court.

clue.text: One judge is in a temper

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
to rate is to assess or judge

explanation.surface: A judge who has lost his temper.
explanation.definitionFit: Irate means very angry, furious.

clue.text: Irish leader embraced by Scandinavian woman

indicators.note: embraced by says the Irish initial sits inside the Scandinavian

parts.note: a Dane is a native of Denmark, a Scandinavian country

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: An Irish politician being hugged by a Norwegian or Swede.
explanation.definitionFit: Diane is a female given name, so it stands for a woman.

clue.text: Lively article I meant to get circulated

parts.note: a is the indefinite article

indicators.note: circulated means the letters of 'I meant' are moved around

explanation.surface: Someone wanting their spirited essay passed around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'circulated' makes NIMATE from I MEANT, after A.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective, animate means living or full of life.

clue.text: Embarrassed a lady in poor accommodation

indicators.note: in shows the lady's pronoun is placed within the word for poor
accommodation adds that poor gives the lady room inside it

parts.note: poor means bad, of low quality
she is the pronoun for a lady

explanation.surface: A woman ashamed of her shabby lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poor accommodation' looks like a shed or slum; in fact BAD accommodates SHE.
explanation.definitionFit: Abashed means made to feel ashamed or awkward.

clue.text: For that reason he came in to negotiate

indicators.note: came in means the pronoun he enters the word for negotiate

parts.note: to treat with someone is to negotiate

explanation.surface: A man arriving to discuss terms.
explanation.definitionFit: Thereat is an archaic word meaning because of that, or at that point.

clue.text: Pressman in pursuit of drug went hell for leather

indicators.note: in pursuit of says the press piece follows behind the drug

parts.note: speed is slang for amphetamine
ed is short for editor, a newspaper man

explanation.surface: A journalist chasing a drug dealer at breakneck pace.
explanation.definitionFit: Speeded means moved fast; hell for leather is an idiom for flat out.
